description: This file is a shell script that defines functions and procedures for configuring and managing a MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) network interface within a larger network configuration system. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up and tearing down the interface, and handling communication with a modem using the umbim tool.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the MBIM protocol, adding various string, boolean, and integer parameters that can be set for the interface.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific fields from the MBIM configuration output by parsing the string lines.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM interface by calling internal setup procedures and handling retries if initial setup fails.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM interface, disconnecting the device and updating system state accordingly.
